analyst_view.overall: Early view: two sides in the bottom half. Beñat San José's Rayo have lost two of their last three but beat Celta 3-0 at home, and expect Valentín and Kumbulla back after the break while Batalla, Luiz Felipe and Álvaro García stay out. Luís Castro's Levante have one point from their last two and have complained to LaLiga about a congested schedule, with games on 23 and 27 November before this trip.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Both sides' season totals point a bit higher (Rayo's games average over three goals), but Levante have scored once in their last three and had no shots on target at Celta. I stay around 2.5-3.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners. Rayo's games swing widely (6 against Elche, 13 at Real Sociedad) and Levante's last two had 7 and 8. I stay around 9-10.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards. Levante are rarely booked (two yellows at Celta, none against Atlético) and Rayo have had two or three per game, while Levante's Adrián de la Fuente is one yellow from a ban. I lean slightly lower, around 4.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.4 shots, which is very high. Rayo took 18 at home to Elche and 11 at Real Sociedad, and Levante managed 6 at Celta, though they had 20 against Atlético. I lean lower, around 27-28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 on target. Rayo put only 3 on target at Real Sociedad and missed a penalty against Elche, and Levante had none on target at Celta. I lean lower, around 8.
